initialExam.title: AWES Teacher 2026 (Army Welfare Education Society)
initialExam.description: AWES conducts screening exam for recruitment of PGT, TGT, and PRT in Army Public Schools across India. These schools cater to children of army personnel.
initialExam.eligibility: B.Ed with Post-Graduate/Graduate degree in relevant subject
initialExam.qualifications: B.Ed mandatory. PGT: Post-Graduate. TGT: Graduate. PRT: Senior Secondary + D.El.Ed.
initialExam.applicationFee: ₹500 for single exam, ₹800 for two exams
initialExam.syllabus: General Awareness, Mental Ability, English Comprehension, Subject-specific knowledge, Teaching methodology.
initialExam.examPattern: Online Screening Exam: 150 questions, 150 marks, 90 minutes.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Screening Exam → Interview at individual Army Public Schools → Selection
initialExam.jobRole: PGT, TGT, PRT in Army Public Schools across India
initialExam.careerGrowth: PRT → TGT → PGT → Vice Principal → Principal.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit awesindia.com 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Appear for exam
initialExam.perks: PF, Gratuity, Medical, School fee concession for children
